answers.how: Measured the 1 cm major markings on the ruler placed on the block (approx. 45.1 px per cm in 960x540 resolution) and used this scale to convert the horizontal width of the wood block (548 px) to 12.1 cm.
Measured the vertical thickness of the wood block's front face (approx. 110 px in 960x540 resolution) and divided by the ruler scale of 45.1 px/cm to get 2.45 cm.

Tracked the pencil tip moving across the top of the block from the right edge at t=2.280s (Frame 57) past the left edge at t=3.400s (Frame 85), covering ~12.9 cm in 1.12 s for an average velocity of ~11.5 cm/s.

Tracked the jigsaw blade cutting across the 12.1 cm width of the wood block from the start of the cut around t=8.5s to completion at t=17.08s (Frame 427), yielding an average cutting velocity of ~1.45 cm/s.
